title: Organization and membership
text: Hosted codes exist before organization choice. A signed-in member selects the organization; its engine owns the authorization after service handoff with explicit actual engine org scope. Repeating that route is idempotent, while another organization refuses and requires a fresh connection. Personal approval stays with the member. Hosted Members retains seats and billing and keeps role/invite controls until the materialized Team contract declares the people destination. Platform continues serving hosted email invitations behind Team. Consumer source adoption is observed; production proof remains pending.
